task.description:
WF-01, step 1 (rework, first of at most two repeats) — rework REQ-104 (and only where the cross-references demand it, REQ-105, REQ-106, REQ-107) by the remarks of the gate in handoffs/E2E-20261103-01/step-02-req-validator.json (read its result yourself: the remarks N1…N7 and the Low remarks of REQ-105/106/107). Rework only by that list; anything beyond it goes into result.issues as a question (AP-019). Do not weaken any criterion.

NEW FACTS since step 01 (owner's answers of 2026-11-03, recorded in decisions/0107-e2e-real-chrome-in-check.md — read it): Chrome IS needed; the end-to-end tests are part of `npm run check`; the "no browser binary" clause of decisions/0023 D2 is lifted for REQ-104…REQ-107 only; a temporary branch `ci/<name>` MAY be pushed to learn whether the GitHub runner has Chrome and deleted after the run (main untouched). REQ-033 stays pending and is NOT decided: do not edit it, and do not write that REQ-107 replaces it.

WHAT TO FIX:
- N1 (blocking): make the departure from 0023 D2 explicit: the description and the relevant criteria name decisions/0107 (a criterion checks that the file exists and that the README prerequisites of tools/ now name Chrome, with the "Chrome missing → red, understandable message, never skip" behaviour). Remove criteria's dependence on the open points I2 and I5.
- N2 (blocking): the GitHub criteria must be answerable at a step that exists: say WHO reads the run (RELEASE-VALIDATOR at WF-02 step 9, or the finalizer waiting for check.yml), AT WHICH step, and BEFORE the push to main — through a run on a temporary `ci/*` branch (decisions/0107, built with the temporary-index snapshot commit as in run ISS-0093-20261028-01), with the exact fact to be read (the Chrome binary found on ubuntu-24.04, the e2e step green, the duration recorded and under the watch value). If the runner has no Chrome, the criterion says what the requirement then demands (an install step in check.yml, pinned by version/SHA like the existing steps) — write both branches as checkable.
- N3…N7 (non-blocking, do them if they fit without growing REQ-104 into two pieces of work): criteria 1 and 11 already met on HEAD → add a "before" value that fails on HEAD or mark them honestly as guards; the criterion-7 loop must not pass on zero tests and must check run order independence; favicon request on first profile load must not collide with the "declared expectation must happen" rule; mention the program plan's own e2e plan (docs/program/public-v1/) in the description only as a related fact, with no dependence. For REQ-105/106/107 keep the cross-references to REQ-104 criteria numbers correct after the rework (renumber nothing if you can; if you must, fix every reference) and take the Low remarks that cost one line.
If the size gate (г) would fail, use the split proposed in step 01 (criteria 1–6 kit, 7–12 command/wiring/CI as a new REQ-108 depending on REQ-104) and fix depends_on of REQ-105…107.

EDIT SCOPE: only the blocks REQ-104…REQ-107 (and a new REQ-108 at the end if you split). Hash of the rest of the file before and after into result; "before copy" of every edited line from `git show base/E2E-20261103-01:docs/requirements.yaml` is not possible for these blocks (they are new in this run) — instead take them from the current file before your edit, into result.before_copy, with the table "what was fixed, where". No name of another project in any text (traces).
acceptance_criteria: Every remark N1..N7 has a line in the table what was fixed / where, or an honest reason
Rest of the file unchanged by hash

N1: the description now names the departure from 0023 D2 / 0022 D7 (only the clause 'no browser binary', only for REQ-104..107), the state of REQ-033 (pending, not decided, two of its criteria conflict with the script e2e, not edited, not 'replaced') and of REQ-014 criterion 3 (not edited, question I1); new criterion 13 checks that decisions/0107 exists and is accepted and that the root README paragraph 'You need' and the section 'Check' of tools/README.md name Chrome and SAI_CHROME and say that without a browser the check fails. The time half of criterion 9 moved to criterion 10; criterion 9 keeps the local budgets.

While it stays as written, its criterion 1 (check without a browser in the system) and criterion 2 (no script named browser or e2e, count 0) cannot hold together with REQ-104. REQ-104 neither depends on it nor says it is replaced. The owner has to say cancel, narrow or keep (jsdom as the first development dependency since 0002).

For the owner via ORCH (gate N6 and N11): is the pure-Node kit meant only for the pages of tools/, while the public-version plan in docs/program/public-v1/ARCHITECTURE.md uses playwright-core for the app folder; and are about 4 minutes more per push on GitHub accepted (the watch value is 25 minutes in criterion 10; PLAN.md lists the Actions minutes as a watched risk). Not a contradiction of a decision, so no criterion depends on the answer.

For ORCH: criterion 10 makes the temporary-branch run mandatory and puts it on RELEASE-VALIDATOR at step 9 (the gate asked for a step that exists before the push). 0107 allows a temporary ci/<name> branch to learn whether the runner has Chrome, 'the way of building the snapshot commit is the one of ISS-0093'. Please confirm that this permission covers the validator's own run on the final files, and that branch B (one pinned install step of Chrome in check.yml, with the replacement of CI-4 and CI-8) is inside 'Chrome is needed, e2e is part of the check'. If the owner wants to be asked first about B, say so and I will turn B into a BLOCKED stop like C. Branch C (Chrome only without its sandbox) is a stop with an owner question in any case; 0107 does not allow --no-sandbox.
